sloka: जानन्न् अपि च किम् कुर्यात् अशक्तिर् अपरिक्रमः ।चिद्यमानम् इव अशक्तः त्रातुम् अन्यो नगो नगम् ॥२-६३-४५॥
transliteration: jānann api ca kim kuryāt aśaktir aparikramaḥ ।cidyamānam iva aśaktaḥ trātum anyo nago nagam ॥2-63-45॥

translations.english: 'What can my weak father who has no strength to walk do, even if he knows about it? Like a tree which cannot protect another which is being severed, he is helpless.
